Record Class BindingsRequest

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
network.ike.knowledge.spi.BindingsRequest
Record Components:
mode - where the declarations come from
outputDirectory - the generated-sources root to write under
packageName - the generated class's package
className - the generated class's simple name
sourceClass - the ledger source class to compose when more than one is discoverable (BindingsRequest.Mode.LEDGER only)
membershipPatterns - for BindingsRequest.Mode.STORE_SCAN, restrict to members of these patterns; empty means every concept and pattern
view - the view specification governing description selection; ViewSpec.empty() means implementation defaults
public record BindingsRequest(BindingsRequest.Mode mode, Path outputDirectory, String packageName, String className, Optional<String> sourceClass, List<ConceptRef> membershipPatterns, ViewSpec view) extends Record
A bindings-generation request: emit a compiler-visible constants class for a knowledge set's declarations (IKE-Network/ike-issues#824) or for a loaded store's concepts and patterns.

    • BindingsRequest

      public BindingsRequest(BindingsRequest.Mode mode, Path outputDirectory, String packageName, String className, Optional<String> sourceClass, List<ConceptRef> membershipPatterns, ViewSpec view)
      Validates and defensively copies the request.
      Parameters:
      mode - where the declarations come from
      outputDirectory - the generated-sources root to write under
      packageName - the generated class's package
      className - the generated class's simple name
      sourceClass - the ledger source class selection
      membershipPatterns - the membership restriction for BindingsRequest.Mode.STORE_SCAN
      view - the view specification
      Throws:
      NullPointerException - if any component is null
      IllegalArgumentException - if packageName or className is blank, membership patterns are given in BindingsRequest.Mode.LEDGER mode, or a source class is given in BindingsRequest.Mode.STORE_SCAN mode
